answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, with the stake held for the whole session. Identity is checked with a fresh proof-of-work echo challenge that cannot be replayed, so one operator cannot spin up cheap clones. Reputation then grows like a garden: every completed trade adds a small time-weighted trust score, and a nebula of accounts funded from the same wallet is flagged and split. An attacker must fund a separate stake and build months of history for each fake identity, while an honest agent pays one small deposit.
